review_vs_original_prenatal_cannabis.rule: If the title or abstract discusses lasting impacts, roles, mechanisms, or broad evidence about prenatal cannabis exposure/endogenous cannabinoids without reporting new author-generated Methods/Results, classify the article as a review rather than original research. Do not infer animal, clinical, inhaled, or pure-cannabinoid administration from studies merely being summarized.

decision_checklist.description: Adds a final classification checklist for upcoming expert decision-chart cues.
decision_checklist.prompt_suffix: Before returning JSON, silently verify: (1) the paper actively administers, measures, or pharmacologically tests cannabis, cannabinoids, or endocannabinoid-system compounds; (2) review/editorial/policy-only papers do not receive original-research extraction values; (3) preclinical host animal strains are not written to strain_reported; (4) route, product type, dose, timing, and sample-size values are grounded in Methods or Results rather than background text.
